purpose: SP5 stage 1: functional inhibition at the measured I-to-E pair (contact 8105899). Specification: docs/specs/2026-09-07-h01-functional-inhibition.md. Registered 2026-09-07, not run.
cache_note: h01-pair is a sparse checkout without .cache; the H01 archive and the interpreter are read from the sibling h01-braincell worktree (sibling_cache()). Traces land in <cache>/h01/inh-<arm>-<ms>ms.npz (gitignored); records in docs/evidence/h01-ie-inhibition/.
wrapper: docs.evidence.h01_i_source_closing_circuit (restores I NaTg closing kinetics; labels the run a functional diagnostic)

registered_stimulus.e_drive_basis: Stimulus choice, not a fit: from the W4 0.4 nA hold (rest -84, -71 at 14.78 ms, -60 at 40 ms) tau_m 27.6 ms, R_in 78 MOhm; 0.6 nA reaches the -57 mV threshold at 24 ms (0.4 nA: 54 ms) and extrapolates to about 20 spikes/s on the donor f-I curve. The alternate 0.8 nA is the single permitted drive change.
registered_stimulus.schedule_rule: one pulse per control cycle, onset = cycle midpoint - 6.78 ms, dropped if < 0 or within 3 ms of the previous pulse

order: approval for 300 ms from the measured benchmark rate

benchmark.prediction: about 425 s at the 4.25 s per simulated ms anchor; E fires >= 1 spike by 100 ms (first spike 20 to 60 ms); I fires once per pulse
benchmark.retains: seconds, seconds_per_simulated_ms, E and I event times (h01-ie-inhibition/run-log.json)

disconnected.prediction: >= 3 E spikes in 300 ms, first between 20 and 60 ms
disconnected.rejection: < 3 E spikes: rerun once with --drive-na 0.8, then stop (stop rule)
disconnected.approval: predicted about 21 min > 15 min: needs the benchmark's measured estimate and approval before launch

measured.prediction: soma IPSP magnitude < 0.05 mV; no E spike or cycle beyond the halving limit; site response 0.5 to 2 mV, depolarising while the site is below -75 mV
measured.rejection: soma IPSP magnitude >= 0.05 mV, or any spike or cycle beyond the limit

soma.placement: inferred: explicit perisomatic hypothesis, not the measured endpoint; labelled in the output JSON (receptor_placement.status)
soma.prediction: soma IPSP magnitude >= 0.3 mV (27.6 pA x 102 MOhm = 2.82 mV; x 4.18/27.6 = 0.43 mV; x 15/20 driving force = 0.32 mV) and >= 1 E spike delayed beyond the shift limit
soma.rejection: soma IPSP magnitude < 0.05 mV: the placement hypothesis is rejected

measured-halved.prediction: same E spike count as measured; per-cycle ranges below 0.1 ms
measured-halved.rejection: count differs: numerically unresolved (no functional verdict)

decision_limit: per control cycle |measured - measured-halved| for shift_ms and connected_cycle_ms; limit = mean range x 2.95 (DLF, two repeats), floor 0.005 ms
gate: functional inhibition = one E spike shifted or one cycle lengthened beyond the limit, or an E spike count change

human_tiers.contract_1mv: not applicable: no human recording of this pair
human_tiers.usable: not applicable: the usable tier scores a single-cell train against a human datum

cost_anchor: 170 s per 40 ms run (W4, measured); 100 ms benchmark before any 300 ms window; every run predicted over 15 min needs a measured estimate and approval
governance: detached via Start-Process; progress line every 60 s; watchdog kill at 10 min without progress; killed = untested
stop_rule: no E spikes (or < 3) in the disconnected control -> one drive change to 0.8 nA, then stop; placement stays the user's decision
